{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the sales data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders to calculate only completed revenue
completed_sales = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of customer_segment across channels
segment_channel_cross = pd.crosstab(completed_sales['channel'], completed_sales['customer_segment'])
print(segment_channel_cross)

# Check if the groups are comparable
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(completed_sales.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True))"}
